newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Mata oil field auction set for Sept 5.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Mata oil field auction set for Sept 5.

text.p: Venezuela's Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) will re-auction the Mata marginal oil field operating contract on Sept 5, not Aug. 20 as had been rumored, PDVSA President Luis Giusti said.
"On September 5 the Mata field will be auctioned with a base price of $85 million," Giusti told a business conference in the Caribbean town Puerto La Cruz, the local Globovision network said.
Local newspapers had suggested earlier this week that the Mata contract would be offered on Aug 20.

Local companies Pivensa and PBE Trading Company were stripped of the field they won at auction in June with a $90 million bid. Their offer beat-out by just three million dollars the second highest bid from Argentina's Perez Companc and Venezuela's Corporacion Corepli.
The Venezuelan consortium was disqualified after another company bought out 75 percent of PBE Trading shares without informing PDVSA.
PBE Trading has been barred from the new auction, although Pivensa may participate. The Mata field currently produces 600 barrels per day and has proven reserves of 101 million barrels.
PDVSA raised more than $2 billion from the bids for 17 operating contracts auction in June.
